theme.zh: 游戏道具制作与团队共享

followup.en:
Your artists can start with text or reference images, generate models in Tripo and refine them in their usual tools. Models shared in the Team Plan library are available for teammates to find and reuse.

For a first trial, your team could pick 10 planned props or characters. Track the work from generation through artist edits and engine checks, then compare the total time and cost with your current process. Include retries and review—not just generation fees. Your team's usual quality requirements still apply.

Files edited outside Tripo stay in your own production workflow.

Tell us what your team is making. We'll discuss the trial scope, access, fees and who does the work before it starts.
followup.zh:
您的美术团队可以从文字或参考图开始，在 Tripo 里生成模型，再用熟悉的工具继续修改。放进 Team Plan 共享资产库的模型，其他成员也能查找和复用。

第一次试用，可以由团队选 10 个计划制作的道具或角色。从生成、美术修改到引擎检查，记录整段流程的工时和成本，再和现有做法比较。重试和审核也算在内，不只看生成费用；质量要求仍按团队原来的标准。

在 Tripo 外修改的文件，继续由团队在自己的制作流程里管理。

留下联系方式，聊聊您的团队正在做什么。开始前会确认试用内容、使用权限、费用和双方分工。

subject.en: 3D props for your next game update
subject.zh: 下一版游戏的 3D 道具

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Is your team making new props for the next game update? With Tripo, your artists can generate starting models from reference images, then refine them for the game. Your team can try this on a few planned props to see whether it saves time overall.

Tripo Studio Team Plan keeps your team's shared models in one library, where artists can find and reuse them. A teammate can pick up a shared model without another file request. Shared credits and member access are managed in the same workspace.

Want to try this with your team? Leave your details to discuss a small project trial with Tripo.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队正在为下一版游戏制作新道具吗？美术可以用 Tripo 从参考图生成初版模型，再继续修改到符合游戏要求。可以先拿计划中的几个道具试试，看看连同后续修改，整体能不能少花些时间。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 把团队共享的模型放在同一个资产库里，方便美术查找和复用。成员需要接着做时，可以直接找到共享模型，少等一次传文件。团队积分和成员权限也在同一个工作区管理。

想让您的团队试试吗？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 聊聊如何用项目里的一小部分资产开始试用。

theme.en: 3D generation in your team's game tools
theme.zh: 在团队现有游戏工具里接入 3D 生成

followup.en:
Your engineers connect your asset tool to Tripo API: submit text or images, track each task and retrieve the model if generation succeeds. Artists then open the result in their usual tools for refinement and review.

A test could use 10 assets from a current project. Your team checks that the files work in its tools and game engine, and records the time to the first approved model, including artist cleanup and review.

The cost comparison can cover generation and retries, the team's work, and integration and maintenance. Your team sets the acceptance requirements and signs off the results.

Leave your details to discuss the assets and setup. Scope, access, fees and responsibilities will be agreed before testing.
followup.zh:
您的工程团队把资产工具接入 Tripo API：提交文字或图片、跟踪任务，在生成成功后取回模型。美术再用平时的软件继续修改和审核。

可以先拿当前项目里的 10 个资产做一次测试。团队检查文件能否接入常用工具和游戏引擎，并记录首个模型通过验收所需的时间，包括美术清理和审核。

比较成本时，计入生成与重试、团队工时，以及接入和维护工作。验收要求由您的团队制定，结果也由团队确认。

留下联系方式，沟通测试资产和接入安排。开始前会确认范围、使用权限、费用和分工。

subject.en: Generate models from references in your own tools
subject.zh: 在自己的工具里，从参考图生成模型

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Is your team adding a way for artists to upload a reference image and generate a starting model inside your asset tool?

Tripo API gives your tool text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation. Your engineers build the connection without having to develop the generation model themselves. Artists can refine the results in the software they already use. Your team keeps control of the tool's interface, project standards and final approval.

Your team could try the API on a few planned assets to compare the total work and cost with its current process.

Leave your details to talk through the integration and a small test with Tripo.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队是否正在给资产工具加入一项功能，让美术上传参考图，就能在工具里生成初版模型？

Tripo API 可以为您的工具提供文生 3D 和图生 3D。工程团队负责接入，不必自研底层生成模型。美术可以在熟悉的软件里继续修改结果；工具界面、项目标准和最终验收，仍由您的团队掌握。

团队可以先用计划制作的几个资产试试，把总工时和成本与现有做法做个比较。

theme.en: 3D product content for your pages and platform
theme.zh: 为产品页面和内容平台制作 3D 展示

followup.en:
Your engineers connect the content platform to Tripo API, send product images and track the generation tasks. If a task succeeds, they retrieve the model for your content team to check and refine. The viewer and publishing process are handled by your team.

A test could cover 10 products from your catalogue. Your team checks the models against the actual products, confirms the file formats and tries them in the page viewer.

The comparison can include the time to the first approved model, generation and retry fees, corrections and review. Integration and viewer maintenance are part of the work too.

Leave your details to discuss the products and platform. Scope, access, costs and responsibilities will be agreed before testing.

可以先用产品目录里的 10 款做测试。团队对照真实产品检查模型，确认文件格式，并在页面查看器里试用。

对比内容包括首个模型通过验收的时间、生成与重试费用、人工修改和审核；接入与查看器维护也属于这部分工作。

subject.en: Adding a 3D view to your product pages?
subject.zh: 准备给产品页面加上 3D 展示吗？

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Is your team adding a 3D view to its product pages, so customers can turn a product around and see it from different angles?

Tripo API turns product images into starting 3D models, so your engineers don't have to build a generation model themselves. Your content team can then check the results against the actual products and refine them for your pages. The API supplies the models; your team connects them to the viewer you use and decides what goes live.

Your team could try this on a few products from the current catalogue, including any corrections needed before the models go live.

Leave your details to discuss the integration and a small test with Tripo.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队准备给产品页面加上 3D 展示，让客户可以转动模型、从不同角度查看产品吗？

Tripo API 可以从产品图片生成初版 3D 模型，工程团队不必自研生成模型。内容团队再对照真实产品检查和修改，用于页面展示。API 提供模型，由您的团队接入所用的查看器，并决定哪些模型可以发布。
